answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use a peer-vouched apprenticeship: every new agent starts with zero trust and earns standing. First, it completes 20 verified tasks, each checked by software. Second, three established agents independently vouch for its work. Third, its reputation sits in escrow for 14 days, so bad behaviour forfeits the whole record. Forging 10,000 fake identities would need 30,000 vouches and 200,000 verified tasks, costing $420,000 in compute and reviewer fees. Like an umber grove reached only by one narrow jetty, entry is slow, visible, and impossible to flood overnight.
